mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 550K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 550K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, always.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 7% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the combined labor market strength predicts increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators' impact on consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when both labor market conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 5% YoY, indicating a strong supply side, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window during tightening cycles, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO growth > 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Real disposable personal income (RSAFS) growth exceeding 4% YoY, signaling robust demand, always predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of instances when RSAFS growth > 4% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises by more than 50bps in a quarter and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) growth remains below 2% YoY, the combination predicts a controlled inflation environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rise > 50bps in a quarter and CPIAUCSL growth < 2% YoY
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 35% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.012 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment (UNRATE) by more than 1% in 6 months, indicating a rapidly improving labor market, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only in post-shock recovery regimes.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 1-year rolling window during post-shock recovery, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE drops > 1% in 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3% YoY, signaling strong economic demand, always predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, except during late-cycle contractions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 3% YoY outside late-cycle contractions, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.
